mavzu: Unit 3 - Lesson 3: Did you clean your desk?

savollar.savol: "Did you clean your desk?" savolining birinchi so'zi qaysi?
Past simple question-larida qaysi so'z assistant vazifa o'ynaydi?
Hafta nechta kundan iborat?
"Water the plants" qanday ma'noni anglatadi?
"Mop the floor" nimani anglatadi?
"I mopped the floor" gapidagi past tense verb qaysi?
Hafta kunlarining to'g'ri tartibi qaysi?
variantlar: Mon, Wed, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat
Tue, Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

savollar.savol: "Thursday" hafta kunlarining nechta kunini tashkil qiladi?
"Play football" ifodada qaysi sport-dan so'z boradi?
"Clean the room" ifodada nechta so'z bor?
"I mopped the floor" gapini savol shakliga o'tqazsa qanday bo'ladi?
"We cleaned the garden" gapini negative (salbiy) holida yozsa qanday bo'ladi?
"They played football" gapini past simple savol shakliga o'tqazsa nima bo'ladi?
Matndagi task-da berilgan harakatchalardan "water the plants" qaysi tartibda turadi?
Matndagi homework-da "watch TV" qayda amalga oshadi?
"Monday" dan so'ng qaysi kun keladi?
"Clean the room" va "mop the floor" harakatchalari qayda birgalikda bajariladi?
Past simple-da auxiliary "did" ishlatilganda, main verb qanday ko'rinishda bo'ladi?
"In the garden" predlogi qaysi ma'noni ifodalaydi?
Matndagi "clean the window" harakati biror joyda bajarilsa, u qayerda?
"Water the plants", "clean the room" va "mop the floor" harakatchalarining umumiy jihati qaysi?
Matndagi "help my parents" mavzusiga asoslanib, quyidagi harakatchalardan qaysilari ota-onaga yordam berish hisoblanmaydi?
variantlar: Water plants, mop floor, wash dishes
Wash dishes, clean garden, mop floor
Clean the room, water the plants, mop the floor
Play football, watch TV, play basketball

savollar.savol: Agar Sardor xonasini Monday, Thursday va Friday-ni tozalasa, u necha kunni tozalamagan?
Past simple question-larni tuzish uchun qo'llanyadigan to'g'ri grammatik pattern qaysi?
Agar 3 ta harakatni (clean, mop, water) hafta har bir kuniga bajarsa, umuman necha ta harakat bajariladi?
Matndagi "They ___ basketball in the gym" gap-da bo'sh joyga qaysi past verb keladi?
Hafta kunlarini teskari tartibda (Sunday dan boshlab) sanasa, "Saturday" qaysi o'rinda bo'ladi?
Matndagi harakatchalarni joyiga qarab guruhlasak, nechta kategorizatsiya va outdoor-da nima bo'ladi?
"Did you clean your desk?" soroviga "No, I didn't" javobiga asoslanib, nima ma'nolashadi?
4-sinf o'quvchisi "Unit 3 - Lesson 3" o'rgangandan so'ng, eng muhim qaysi ko'nikmasiga ega bo'ladi?
variantlar: O'rganilgan pattern-ga asoslanib yangi past simple gaplarni tuzish qobiliyati
